hooks.command: grep -qE '\bgit\b[^"]*\b(commit|push)\b' || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; out=$(vp exec fallow audit --base origin/trunk --format json --quiet --explain --gate-marker agent 2>&1); [ $? -eq 1 ] || exit 0; printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2

path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); echo "$path" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs|css|json|md)$' || exit 0; vp_bin="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/vp"; [ -x "$vp_bin" ] || vp_bin=vp; "$vp_bin" fmt "$path" --write
